title: We Almost Answered the Phone With Ahoy
hook: Bell, who invented the telephone, wanted calls to start with ahoy instead of hello
summary: Bell wanted ahoy as the phone greeting, but Edison's hello caught on.

text: When the telephone first came along, there was one problem.
What do you say when you pick it up?
Alexander Graham Bell, the inventor of the telephone,
suggested ahoy, a greeting used on ships.

panels.mean: a call ships used to hail each other

text: But the word Thomas Edison used won out.
hello spread far and wide as a greeting.
Now ahoy is something people say for fun
when they're putting on a pirate voice.

panels.text: Maybe I'll start answering calls with ahoy today
